SLAG

240minutes
68solder joints
difficulty

A leverless fight-game controller on GP2040-CE

Heat the pad and the pin together for two seconds. Feed solder into the joint, not onto the iron. Take the solder away first, then the iron.

Strip 3 mm, twist the strands, and tin the end before you solder it to a pad.

Unplug USB and disconnect any battery before you solder or change a wire. Work on a surface that does not burn, and wash your hands after handling solder.

Before you switch it on

  1. Look. Every joint is a shiny cone. No solder touches a neighbouring pad. No stray strands of wire.
  2. These must not beep. Set the multimeter to continuity and probe each pair. A beep means a short: find it before you plug in.
    3V3GND
  3. These must beep. Probe the two ends of every connection.
    3V3Pico 3V3 · Display VCC
    GNDPico GND.1 · Display GND
    I2C_SDAPico GP0 · Display SDA
    I2C_SCLPico GP1 · Display SCL
    BTN_LEFTPico GP5 · Left 1
    GNDPico GND.2 · Left 2 · Down 2 · Right 2 · Up 2
    BTN_DOWNPico GP3 · Down 1
    BTN_RIGHTPico GP4 · Right 1
    BTN_UPPico GP2 · Up 1
    BTN_B3Pico GP10 · B3 1
    GNDPico GND.3 · B3 2 · B4 2 · R1 2 · L1 2 · L2 2 · R2 2 · B2 2 · B1 2
    BTN_B4Pico GP11 · B4 1
    BTN_R1Pico GP12 · R1 1
    BTN_L1Pico GP13 · L1 1
    BTN_L2Pico GP9 · L2 1
    BTN_R2Pico GP8 · R2 1
    BTN_B2Pico GP7 · B2 1
    BTN_B1Pico GP6 · B1 1
    BTN_S1Pico GP16 · S1 1
    GNDPico GND.4 · S1 2 · S2 2 · A1 2
    BTN_S2Pico GP17 · S2 1
    BTN_A1Pico GP20 · A1 1
  4. Plug in. Nothing gets warm, nothing smells. If something does, unplug at once and go back to step 2.
  5. Flash the bring-up test. It reports every part it can find before you load the real firmware.pio run -e bringup -t upload && pio device monitor
43SLAG-WIRE-1

Slag is built

Slag is an all-button (leverless) arcade controller for fighting games: four direction buttons under the left hand, eight action buttons under the right, three function buttons and a small status display. A Raspberry Pi Pico runs the open-source GP2040-CE firmware, so it works as an XInput, Switch, PS3 or PS4 legacy controller, and every button and SOCD rule is set in a web page served by the controller itself.
